# The Korea Times features Burford patent experts Katharine Wolanyk and Christopher Freeman


- Patent & IP


September 25, 2024


-
-
-
-


*The Korea Times* previews a *[Burford Quarterly](https://www.burfordcapital.com/insights-news-events/burford-quarterly/)* article on patent monetization by[Katharine Wolanyk](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/katharine-wolanyk/) and[Christopher Freeman](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-freeman/) . The article highlights the growing trend of Korean companies recognizing their patents as valuable financial assets.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/biz/2024/09/126_383111.html)
